context: M4 o7. 37th & Seventh, the morning jam. Augie Lomax steps out of the crowd, cigar in his teeth.

lines.speaker: char.augie_lomax
lines.text: You're the guy on my driver's case on Twenty-Ninth. Wait. I know you.

lines.speaker: char.augie_lomax
lines.text: Arce. Christmas list, Midtown. You took a turkey and a fifty. Sixty-nine.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Seventy. And it was a ham.

lines.speaker: char.augie_lomax
lines.text: Thirty-Seventh's a parking lot seven to ten. That's not traffic. That's my office.

lines.speaker: char.augie_lomax
lines.text: You carry for Feld, fine. You carry opinions, you carry 'em someplace else.
